description: This file contains unit tests for functions that generate and resolve Telegram inline buttons, testing their behavior with various input scenarios.

methods.name: buildTelegramInteractiveButtons
methods.description: Generates Telegram inline button rows from shared button and select blocks, respecting Telegram's payload size limits.

methods.name: resolveTelegramInlineButtons
methods.description: Resolves to explicit inline button definitions, preferring explicitly provided buttons over derived ones from interactive payloads.

ctags.name: explicit
ctags.pattern: /^    const explicit = [[{ text: "Keep", callback_data: "keep" }]] as const;$/
